Titel: Finance Transformation Manager R2R (f/m/x) - 6 month contract
Unternehmen: Northvale Payments GmbH
Ort: Berlin, Berlin, Germany (Remote)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4109457733/
Abgerufen am: 25.09.2026 07:30

About the job
Northvale Payments is a fast-growing payment service provider with offices in Berlin, Lisbon and Dublin. After two acquisitions in 2025 our finance function runs on three different ledgers, and our month-end close takes 14 working days. We want to get it down to 6.

What you will do
Own the Record to Report (R2R) transformation roadmap and drive it end to end
Harmonise the chart of accounts across 7 legal entities
Redesign the close calendar and implement BlackLine for reconciliations and journal entries
Work closely with our Group Financial Controller and the ERP team (the move from NetSuite to SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud is in selection)
Build KPIs for close quality and make them visible in Looker

What you bring
6+ years in finance transformation, either in Big 4 advisory or in-house
Hands-on experience with close acceleration and reconciliation tools (BlackLine, Trintech or similar)
Solid accounting background (IFRS), ideally in fintech or financial services
Comfortable with ambiguity and a start-up pace
English is our company language, German is a plus

Contract details
Start ASAP, latest 01/11/2026
6 months, extension likely
Fully remote within the EU, occasional on-site workshops in Berlin (travel paid)
Day rate €650–750 depending on experience, invoiced monthly

We value diversity and welcome applications from all backgrounds. No agencies please.
